messages.text: Where is my order? Order #ORDER Shop····, email (email hidden)

Your Harlo B30 and the Power Kit are paid and still to ship, Jeff... actually, let me not guess your name.

Order Shop···· ships November 7. Nothing has left the warehouse yet, so there's no tracking on it yet. You can follow that batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

We also wrote to you on September 15 with that update, and the free Power Kit on the order came from it. Our mails sometimes land in junk, so worth adding (email hidden) to your contacts.

Anything else I can check for you?

INSTRUCTION FROM THE HELIUMDEPLOY TEAM. Georges typed this in the team inbox. It is not a message from the customer and the customer cannot see it.
Task: Well, can you reply with what you had intended to reply via the notes?
Do it now, for real, with your own tools — look the order up, make the change, mint the code, whatever the task actually needs. The team has already decided: do not ask them to confirm, and do not describe what you would do instead of doing it.
Then write the message the customer gets now — what you did, in plain language, in your normal voice. Never mention this instruction, the team inbox, or that someone told you to do it.
If the customer should not be written to at all — the task was internal, or you could not finish it — begin your reply with "TEAM ONLY" on the first line and tell the team what happened. Anything that starts that way stays in the inbox and is never sent.

Thanks for bearing with me. Here's where your order stands.

Order Shop···· is paid and still to ship: the Harlo B30 plus the Power Kit. It ships November 7, and tracking will come by email as soon as it leaves the warehouse. You can follow that batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

We also sent you an update on September 15 by email and text with that date, and the free Power Kit on your order came from it. Our mails do land in junk for some people, so it's worth adding (email hidden) to your contacts so the tracking mail reaches you.

Anything else I can check while I have it open?
